item.title: Notre Dame professor breaks down US and Israeli strikes on Iran
item.description: SOUTH BEND, Ind. -- International experts are questioning the President's decision to join Israel in "Attacking Iran" without consulting Congress.

item.title: Family remembers man who died after bullet ricochets while racoon hunting
item.description: FULTON COUNTY, Ind. -- Andrew Boots is being remembered for his love of family, the outdoors, and Christ after a hunting accident on Saturday night.

item.title: Family of Bryan Axel Ramirez Gomez calls for independent investigation
item.description: ELKHART, Ind. -- The family of Bryan Axel Ramirez Gomez and the community of Elkhart County are organizing a petition calling for an independent federal and state review of the officer involved shooting of the 17-year-old.

item.title: Fulton county residents react to data center moratorium
item.description: FULTON COUNTY, Ind. — With the 2-1 passing of a one-year data center moratorium Monday night, many in Fulton County are left with the question: What's next?

item.title: “Black out” continues at The Jefferson Apartments as common areas remain dark for three weeks
item.description: SOUTH BEND, Ind. — Residents at The Jefferson Apartments in South Bend say they have been dealing with a "black out" for three weeks.

item.title: Notre Dame women open ACC Tournament play as No. 5 seed, seek momentum for NCAA push
item.description: SOUTH BEND, Ind. -- The road to March Madness begins this week for Notre Dame.

item.title: St. Jospeh County residents share concerns over dewatering permit request
item.description: ST. JOSEPH COUNTY, Ind. -- Residents shared their concerns with the county council on Tuesday due to Amazon requesting to pump 1.5 million gallons of water per hour into the Niespodziany Ditch as part of a dewatering plan.

item.title: National clinic with South Bend roots expands access to care for rare disease Ehlers-Danlos syndrome
item.description: SOUTH BEND, Ind. -- Joint pain, headaches, dizziness and allergic reactions can send many people to the doctor. For others, those symptoms are daily life with Ehlers-Danlos syndrome, a rare genetic disorder that specialists say is more common than once believed.

item.title: Hannah Hidalgo named ACC Player of the Year and Defensive Player of the Year
item.description: SOUTH BEND, Ind. -- Hannah Hidalgo has been announced as the ACC Player of the Year for the second season in a row and ACC Defensive Player of the Year for a third season.

item.title: Candidates meet community members at Meet the Candidates event
item.description: ST. JOSEPH, Mich. -- The Silver Harbor Brewing Company hosted a Meet the Candidates event where people from the community came and met with candidates who are running for US Congress, Michigan State House, and Berrien County District Judge.
